about: A memory in the state working agents leave it in: lessons that changed, the same thing noted twice, a first guess that was corrected, and things that look alike but are not. The consolidation routine is run on it and the result is checked. It also holds instructions for single jobs, one of which the job's definition already says and one of which it contradicts, and a note that adds to an entry without correcting it; the routine may read the definitions (definitions, below) as the dreamer reads its installation's.

entries.text: On this machine the default kubectl context is a shared production cluster. The local development cluster is the context named devvm, so every kubectl command for local work must include --context devvm.
entries.flag: Outdated: the devvm context no longer exists; the local cluster was rebuilt and its context is now lima-dev (told by user)

entries.text: On this machine the default kubectl context is a shared production cluster. The local development cluster's context is lima-dev (renamed from devvm after a rebuild), so every kubectl command for local work must include --context lima-dev.
The staging cluster's kubectl context is named stage-eu. Read-only commands there need no approval; anything that changes state does.
All JavaScript projects in this organisation use pnpm, never npm (npm install produces a broken lockfile with the registry). Install command: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
entries.flag: Outdated: the organisation moved from pnpm to bun (user said so); pnpm is no longer installed

entries.text: All JavaScript projects in this organisation use bun, not pnpm or npm. Commands: bun install, bun add, bun remove. pnpm is not installed on the machines any more.

entries.evidence: Wrote this into the manifest for the checkout deployment.
entries.text: Spread replicas across zones with a hard topology spread constraint (whenUnsatisfiable: DoNotSchedule) so two replicas never share a zone.
entries.flag: Wrong: the user says hard spread constraints left pods pending here; use soft constraints

entries.text: Keep topology spread constraints soft (whenUnsatisfiable: ScheduleAnyway). Hard constraints left pods pending because the cluster autoscaler ignores pod topology.

entries.evidence: go test failed on three date tests until I exported TZ=UTC.
entries.text: The api test suite fails unless TZ=UTC is set.
Set the TZ environment variable to UTC before running the api tests; three date tests assume it and fail in any other zone.
Production deploys are frozen on Fridays from 14:00.
No production deploys on Friday afternoons, or on the day before a public holiday.
The build cache lives on the shared volume at /mnt/cache and is wiped every Sunday night.
entries.flag: It was not wiped on the last two Sundays; has the schedule changed?

entries.text: Terraform plan runs against production unless the staging workspace is selected first.
Terraform for the local cluster has no remote state: run it from the infra/local directory or it plans against the staging state.
The owner prefers answers that open with the conclusion and put the supporting evidence after it.
Start every answer with the conclusion, then the evidence; the owner reads the first line and may stop there.
Protobuf code in this repository is generated with buf generate; never edit the files under gen/proto by hand.
Regenerate the protobuf code with buf generate. The files under gen/proto are generated and must not be edited by hand.
Do not force push to a shared branch; make a revert commit instead.
The integration tests fail on a fresh database until scripts/seed.sh has been run.

entries.evidence: The integration suite failed with missing fixtures until I ran the seed script.
entries.text: Run scripts/seed.sh before the integration tests; they need its fixtures.
The agent may commit and push to feature branches without asking first.
The weekly price review posts its result as a comment on its tracking ticket, and sends no direct message about it.
The sheet-sync agent runs every night at 02:00 UTC.
The staging database is restored from the nightly snapshot every Sunday at 03:00 UTC.
After the Sunday staging restore, scripts/anonymise.sh runs on the restored data before anyone may use it.

checks.name: the renamed context's old entry is gone
the replaced package manager's old entry is gone
the corrected first guess is gone
the new context is still there and trusted
bun is still there and trusted
soft spread is still there with its reason
the staging context was not merged into the local one
no current entry still tells agents to use devvm
no current entry still tells agents to use pnpm
the two TZ notes became one, keeping the detail and the person's backing
the two freeze notes, merged or left for the owner, kept both details
the flagged entry nobody corrected was left alone
the two Terraform pitfalls stayed separate
the unrelated lessons were not touched
a preference learned in two repositories became one entry that applies everywhere
a tool two repositories share was not shown to every repository
a repository's copy of a global rule is gone, and the global rule stayed global
two notes merged within a repository stayed in that repository
a permission given in one repository was not made global
a job's instruction that its definition holds is retired, naming the definition
a job's instruction that its definition contradicts is kept and asked about
a note that adds to an entry is not treated as a correction

definitions.agents.yaml:
# This installation's agents.
agents:
  - name: price-review
    routines: [price-review]
    schedule: 0 20 * * 1
    models: [claude-opus-5-5]
    tools: all
  - name: sheet-sync
    routines: [sheet-sync]
    schedule: 0 4 * * *
    models: [claude-haiku-5-5]
    tools: all
definitions.price-review.md:
# Weekly price review

Compare this week's prices with last week's and decide whether the rule is met.

## Reporting

Post the result as a comment on the tracking ticket. Do not send a direct message about it.
definitions.sheet-sync.md:
# Sheet sync

Copy the pricing sheet into the database. Stop if the sheet has fewer rows than yesterday.
